implemented_commands.vkCmdPipelineBarrier2: Validates DependencyInfo and Memory/Buffer/ImageMemoryBarrier2 chains, including core MEMORY_READ and MEMORY_WRITE access domains, enforces dynamic-rendering local-read and traditional render-pass self-dependency scopes (attachment-only framebuffer barriers where required), requires VK_DEPENDENCY_BY_REGION_BIT whenever dynamic or traditional framebuffer-space source stages are used, normalizes promoted 64-bit stage aliases before those scope checks, lowers mixed barriers through the union of their canonical source/destination stages without over-broadening graphics-only self-dependencies to ALL_COMMANDS, maps supported Vulkan 1.3/1.4 64-bit transfer, vertex-input, compute, pre-raster, and shader access aliases into the canonical barrier contract, and preserves transactional command recording for unknown stage or access bits.
implemented_commands.vkCmdSetEvent2: Validates synchronization2 dependency-info ABI, records signal provenance and a pointer-independent dependency key, single-device command-buffer masks, and outside-render-pass scope, rejects forbidden BY_REGION/asymmetric event flags under the advertised policy, accepts valid empty dependencies, records non-empty dependency barriers for layout/stale-resource tracking, and records an owned event set with all-commands stage semantics; invalid dependencies roll back without retaining a partial barrier.
implemented_commands.vkCmdResetEvent2: Validates the Vulkan 1.3 VkPipelineStageFlags2 ABI, single-device command-buffer masks, and outside-render-pass scope, accepts VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_NONE, lowers supported non-host stage masks to the owned event-reset path, and rejects unsupported or host stage bits without recording.
implemented_commands.vkCmdWaitEvents2: Validates bounded event and dependency-info arrays plus the single-device command-buffer mask, rejects legacy vkCmdSetEvent signals, requires a pointer-independent key match with the latest vkCmdSetEvent2 dependency, folds recorded reset operations when selecting the latest signal provenance, restricts host-signaled events to HOST-or-NONE first-scope source stages, rejects forbidden BY_REGION/asymmetric event flags under the advertised policy, applies the dynamic-rendering local-read and traditional render-pass self-dependency scope rules to every per-event dependency, accepts per-event empty dependencies, records each event/dependency pair in order, and rolls back all newly recorded commands if a later pair fails canonical synchronization validation.
implemented_commands.vkCmdWriteTimestamp2: Validates the Vulkan 1.3 single-stage synchronization2 timestamp domain, normalizes supported 64-bit stage aliases, and records exact timestamp query writes through the canonical query implementation.
implemented_commands.vkQueueSubmit2: Converts bounded Vulkan 1.3 SubmitInfo2 semaphore and command-buffer arrays into the canonical submission path, accepts zero-submit calls with null arrays, accepts VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_NONE semaphore scopes and a zero single-device command-buffer mask, normalizes supported 64-bit aliases while preserving timeline values, rejects nonzero values on binary semaphores, and retains ownership and transactional validation.
implemented_commands.vkCmdBeginRendering: Validates Vulkan 1.3 dynamic-rendering attachment ABI, accepts VK_RENDERING_CONTENTS_SECONDARY_COMMAND_BUFFERS_BIT while rejecting unsupported suspend/resume flags, checks supported attachment layouts against each image's tracked current layout, optional color/depth attachment usage and ownership including fully attachmentless scopes, bounded nonzero layerCount against the device max and array-view layer ranges, attachmentless extents against the framebuffer limits, and explicit load/store enum domains including VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_NONE and VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_NONE; records finite loadOp=CLEAR values for every selected layer (including depth-only scopes), records explicit DONT_CARE or promoted LOAD_OP_NONE content discards before any clear, permits framebuffer-free indexed CPU-cube draws against color-bearing attachment views, depth-only CPU-cube draws against a D32 attachment, and rasterizer-discard draws with no color target, records store-none discard semantics at vkCmdEndRendering, and requires a matching vkCmdEndRendering before command-buffer completion.
implemented_commands.vkCmdEndRendering: Closes an owned dynamic-rendering scope with exact command-buffer lifecycle checks, records DONT_CARE or promoted STORE_OP_NONE content discards for selected attachment layers, rejects an active occlusion query because query scope is nested inside rendering, and preserves active state on the failure-atomic rejection.
implemented_commands.vkGetDeviceGroupPeerMemoryFeatures: Returns the truthful zero peer-memory feature mask for ZPU's single-device group with bounded heap/device index validation.
implemented_commands.vkCreateSamplerYcbcrConversion: Validates the complete Vulkan 1.1 sampler-YCbCr conversion ABI, including model/range/component/chroma/filter/boolean domains and the zero external-format policy, before returning the explicit format-not-supported result because ZPU advertises no multi-planar YCbCr formats; malformed payloads leave the output handle untouched.
implemented_commands.vkDestroySamplerYcbcrConversion: Accepts the Vulkan 1.1 YCbCr conversion destruction ABI as an idempotent no-op because unsupported conversions never publish handles.
implemented_commands.vkCmdSetLineStipple: Validates Vulkan 1.4 line-stipple factor and pattern state in recording scope, marks the state initialized for VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_LINE_STIPPLE, resets it at command-buffer lifecycle boundaries, and retains it in direct and indirect draw snapshots with allocation-free warm recording.
implemented_commands.vkCmdBindIndexBuffer2: Binds an owned live memory-backed index buffer while retaining the explicit Vulkan 1.4 range (including VK_WHOLE_SIZE), enforcing index-type-sized offsets and explicit ranges plus ownership and draw-range validation transactionally.
implemented_commands.vkMapMemory2: Validates Vulkan 1.4 MemoryMapInfo ABI and delegates bounded coherent mapping to the owned memory mapper.
implemented_commands.vkUnmapMemory2: Validates Vulkan 1.4 MemoryUnmapInfo ABI and returns an owned-memory lifecycle result through the canonical unmapper.
implemented_commands.vkCmdBindVertexBuffers2: Atomically binds owned live vertex buffers while retaining optional Vulkan 1.3/1.4 per-binding sizes and strides; VK_WHOLE_SIZE ranges normalize to each buffer tail, finite ranges remain bounded by the offset and buffer size, strides stay within the advertised vertex-input limit, and a non-NULL pStrides pointer initializes VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_VERTEX_INPUT_BINDING_STRIDE per binding (including exact zero values), with validated empty binding ranges accepted when optional arrays are omitted.
implemented_commands.vkCmdBindDescriptorSets2: Validates Vulkan 1.4 BindDescriptorSetsInfo ABI, accepts only the advertised core shader-stage mask (including the Vulkan all-stages alias), retains the normalized stage mask while recording the selected graphics or compute bind point for subsequent command validation and dispatch consumption, and delegates bounded owned descriptor binding and aligned dynamic offsets to the canonical descriptor path.
implemented_commands.vkCmdPushConstants2: Validates Vulkan 1.4 PushConstantsInfo ABI and delegates exact stage, range, ownership, and per-stage byte updates to the canonical push-constant path.
implemented_commands.vkCmdSetRenderingAttachmentLocations: Validates Vulkan 1.4 dynamic-rendering attachment-location state transactionally; the command is accepted only inside an active vkCmdBeginRendering scope, and the executable profile requires exactly one location at attachment location zero.
implemented_commands.vkCmdSetRenderingInputAttachmentIndices: Validates Vulkan 1.4 dynamic-rendering input-attachment index state transactionally; the command is accepted only inside an active vkCmdBeginRendering scope, and the executable profile requires exactly one color index at zero with no depth/stencil indices.
implemented_commands.vkCmdPushDescriptorSet: Atomically applies supported uniform-buffer, storage-buffer, and combined-image push writes to command-local descriptor state for graphics or compute bind points, preserving prior state on invalid ownership, range, layout, or binding input.
implemented_commands.vkCmdPushDescriptorSet2: Validates the Vulkan 1.4 stage/layout/write ABI, retains the normalized stage mask while recording the selected graphics or compute bind point for subsequent command validation and dispatch consumption, and applies the same bounded command-local push-descriptor state transition.
implemented_commands.vkCmdPushDescriptorSetWithTemplate: Validates the Vulkan ABI without a legacy bind-point parameter, derives graphics or compute routing from the owned descriptor-update template, enforces its recorded pipeline-layout identity when present, and atomically decodes supported uniform-buffer, storage-buffer, or combined-image writes into command-local push state.
implemented_commands.vkCmdPushDescriptorSetWithTemplate2: Validates PushDescriptorSetWithTemplateInfo2 ABI, routes through the template's recorded graphics or compute bind point, and delegates owned template decoding and atomic push-state application to the canonical path.
implemented_commands.vkCreateDescriptorUpdateTemplate: Creates a bounded owned descriptor-update template with exact entry ABI, descriptor-set or Vulkan 1.4 push-descriptor template type, graphics or compute bind point, push-layout/pipeline-layout ownership when required, static or dynamic uniform-buffer, storage-buffer, or combined-image descriptor type, and failure-atomic registry behavior.
implemented_commands.vkDestroyDescriptorUpdateTemplate: Tombstones an owned descriptor-update template and rejects stale or cross-device destruction.
implemented_commands.vkUpdateDescriptorSetWithTemplate: Atomically applies only descriptor-set templates (rejecting Vulkan 1.4 push-descriptor templates) for bounded static or dynamic uniform-buffer, storage-buffer, and combined-image entries with exact offsets, ranges, alignment, lifecycle checks, and rollback when any later template entry is invalid.
implemented_commands.vkCopyMemoryToImage: Validates bounded host-pointer-to-image copies for the advertised RGBA8 UNORM and BGRA8 UNORM formats, with exact current-layout, 2D region/depth, matching multi-layer subresources, checked row/layer pitches, ownership, pNext, and transactional validation semantics; accepts VK_HOST_IMAGE_COPY_MEMCPY_BIT only for full-image zero-offset regions.
implemented_commands.vkCopyImageToMemory: Validates bounded image-to-host-pointer copies for the advertised RGBA8 UNORM and BGRA8 UNORM formats, with exact current-layout, 2D region/depth, matching multi-layer subresources, checked row/layer pitches, ownership, pNext, and transactional validation semantics; accepts VK_HOST_IMAGE_COPY_MEMCPY_BIT only for full-image zero-offset regions.
implemented_commands.vkCopyImageToImage: Executes bounded host image-to-image copies only for identical RGBA8 UNORM or BGRA8 UNORM parameters and non-overlapping memory/regions, with exact current-layout, 2D region/depth, matching multi-layer subresources, ownership, and pNext validation; accepts VK_HOST_IMAGE_COPY_MEMCPY_BIT only for full-image zero-offset regions.
implemented_commands.vkTransitionImageLayout: Atomically validates and applies bounded host image layout transitions, accepting UNDEFINED/PREINITIALIZED or the tracked host-copy layouts as old layouts and only GENERAL/TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL/TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL as destinations, with current-layout, subresource, duplicate-image, ownership, and stale-handle checks.
implemented_commands.vkGetImageSubresourceLayout2: Validates Vulkan 1.4 ImageSubresource2/SubresourceLayout2 ABI, accepts the promoted VkSubresourceHostMemcpySize output chain, and returns exact owned-image layout metadata including the selected array-layer offset, per-layer size, and host memcpy size.
implemented_commands.vkGetDeviceImageSubresourceLayout: Validates the live-device ownership boundary, then computes exact bounded per-array-layer subresource layout offsets, sizes, pitches, and VkSubresourceHostMemcpySize output directly from image-create and subresource ABI without publishing an image; null or stale devices leave output untouched.
implemented_commands.vkGetRenderingAreaGranularity: Validates RenderingAreaInfo, including the supported color/depth attachment format domains and zero-view policy, and returns the ZPU one-pixel rendering granularity without mutating output on malformed or unsupported queries.
